name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Exactly one of these is true: Judit goes with Pin; Magnus goes with Zwischenzug; Magnus goes with 1430.
Between 1430 and 1530, one goes with Garry and the other with Judit.
The player who loves the Discovery's rating is lower than both Garry and the player who loves the Pin.
Either Garry goes with 1430 or Magnus goes with Pin.
